name: North Siders
description: The North Siders were a prison gang formed in the Illinois state prison system by Joe Ganci, a member of the Thorndale Jarvis Organization (TJO). Ganci organized the group to provide protection for white gang members incarcerated in Illinois institutions including Cook County Jail, Pontiac, Menards, and Dixon. Membership drew from Chicago street gangs including the Gaylords, Chi-West, and Playboys. After the North Siders dissolved, many of its constituent gangs joined the People and Folk alliances.
